## Expected

1. Exit 0.
2. Stdout: `installed ~/.local/bin/xdev-agent (alias xdev → <xdev URL>)`.
3. Stderr: `warning: no token saved for <xdev URL>` plus the fix hint
   `xdev-agent config set --token-stdin`.
4. The wrapper exists, is `0755`, and is exactly:

   ```sh
   #!/bin/sh
   # generated by remote-agent alias install (alias: xdev); do not edit
   exec remote-agent --alias xdev "$@"
   ```

5. The alias store holds one entry `xdev` / `xdev-agent` / `<xdev URL>`.
6. Neither server received a request (add is local-only).

## Exit Code

0.

```go
import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/xhd2015/doctest/session"
)

func Assert(t *testing.T, _ *session.Doctest, req *Request, resp *Response, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Run error: %v", err)
	}
	if resp.ExitCode != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("exit %d; combined:\n%s", resp.ExitCode, resp.Combined)
	}
	wantInstalled := "installed ~/.local/bin/" + aliasLeafBinary + " (alias " + aliasLeafName + " → " + resp.AliasURL + ")"
	if !strings.Contains(resp.Stdout, wantInstalled) {
		t.Fatalf("stdout missing %q:\n%s", wantInstalled, resp.Stdout)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(resp.Stderr, "warning: no token saved for "+resp.AliasURL) {
		t.Fatalf("stderr missing the missing-token warning:\n%s", resp.Stderr)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(resp.Stderr, aliasLeafBinary+" config set --token-stdin") {
		t.Fatalf("stderr missing the config set hint:\n%s", resp.Stderr)
	}

	wantBody := "#!/bin/sh\n" +
		aliasMarkerPrefix + aliasLeafName + "); do not edit\n" +
		"exec remote-agent --alias " + aliasLeafName + " \"$@\"\n"
	if resp.WrapperAfter != wantBody {
		t.Fatalf("wrapper body = %q, want %q", resp.WrapperAfter, wantBody)
	}
	info, statErr := os.Stat(resp.Wrapper)
	if statErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("stat wrapper: %v", statErr)
	}
	if info.Mode().Perm() != 0755 {
		t.Fatalf("wrapper mode = %v, want 0755", info.Mode().Perm())
	}

	if got := aliasStoreNames(t, resp.StoreJSON); len(got) != 1 || got[0] != aliasLeafName {
		t.Fatalf("store names = %v, want [xdev]\n%s", got, resp.StoreJSON)
	}
	if got := aliasStoreServers(t, resp.StoreJSON)[aliasLeafName]; got != resp.AliasURL {
		t.Fatalf("store server = %q, want %q", got, resp.AliasURL)
	}

	if resp.DefaultHits != 0 || resp.AliasHits != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("alias add must not contact a server (default=%d alias=%d)", resp.DefaultHits, resp.AliasHits)
	}
}
```
